# bob gmail

Save Gmail threads as inert mail notes, linked from tasks

```text title="bob gmail --help"
Gmail threads you choose become inert, append-only mail notes: one read-only login through gog, then save threads offline and link them from tasks. Every send goes through a previewed Gmail draft. Bare `bob gmail` lists saved threads.

Usage: bob gmail [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  doctor  Check the Gmail setup: gog, client, account, token, scopes, config, writer, and journal
  login   Connect Gmail (read-only) in one guided step
  logout  Remove Bob's Gmail grant only; prints the Google revoke URL
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: table or json

          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

Running `bob gmail` with no command lists saved threads (offline, read-only).

Examples:
  bob gmail                   List saved threads
  bob gmail -f json           List saved threads as JSON
  bob gmail login             Connect Gmail in one guided step
  bob gmail login -a EMAIL    Sign in as this account
  bob gmail login -s compose  Also grant the compose scope (Mac only)
  bob gmail doctor            Diagnose gog, the client, and the vault
  bob gmail logout -y         Remove Bob's Gmail grant only

Environment:
  BOB_DIR            Bob vault root; defaults to ~/bob
  BOB_CONFIG_FILE    gmail config; defaults to ~/.config/bob/config.yml
  BOB_GMAIL_GOG      gog executable replacing `gog` on PATH
  BOB_GMAIL_BROWSER  Browser executable; selects browser sign-in (otherwise automatic)
```
